issues.reason: A bare kind is the licensed filler for a non-specific / generic argument — the instruction set's own `(Patient sk_cook_1 dinner)` does exactly this — and a role slot is not a class position, so the `Member`-vs-`Inheritance` individual/class discipline is untouched and nothing is ill-typed; what is genuinely unsettled is whether a kind-level state may be reified at all, which belongs in the gap column and is filed there.

`(Inheritance distillation heavy) (STV 1.0 0.9)` predicates heaviness of the kind at large with the stated 'from early autumn to Lantern-night' window stripped, which Core patterns' no-silent-dropping bar and the restricted-kind-claim rule's explicit 'never strip the restriction and assert the bare `(Inheritance …)`' both forbid.

gaps_confirmed: a kind-level property restricted to a stated TIME INTERVAL ('X is P from A to B'): `ConditionalProperty`'s condition slot is defined for a state/environment (and by the locative rule a place), not a from/to window; `Start`/`End` attach to an eventuality, not a kind; and the copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit rule that mandates the flat half was written for individual subjects, so the two doctrines conflict here with no stated resolution
new_gaps: whether a KIND-level state may be reified at all is undetermined: every reified-state trigger (predicate-adjective state, connective endpoint, copular-with-time-modifier, adjective's PP complement) is illustrated with an individual or witness bearer, so nothing licenses or forbids `(Experiencer <state-witness> <kind>)` — even though that reified half is the only half here able to carry the stated interval
defect_summary: The compliant form drops the unrestricted flat half `(Inheritance distillation heavy)` and keeps only the interval-bounded reified state, which does carry the restriction, recording the gap — no restriction-preserving flat form is licensed, since `ConditionalProperty`'s condition slot has no interval shape.
notes: The `Name` atom plus kind-word-inside-the-name typing for 'Lantern-night' and the `Start`/`End` interval on the state witness are correct. The empirical 0.9 confidence spread onto the structural `Experiencer`/`Start`/`End` atoms is a minor deviation the reviewer rightly left as a note rather than an issue.
